title: One-step gate-hit transition
statement: Let $[0mn$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a bit string, let $o$ be an oracle, and let $[0m\tau$ be a scan task. Suppose the input formed from $n$ and $w$ has target vertex $tv$ (and source $iv$ for an edge task). If the scan instruction at label $l$ is the task's hit instruction with successor labels $l_1,l_0$, then one machine step from label $l$ with registers $(p,c,a)$ leaves the registers unchanged and moves to $l_1$ when $c=tv$, and to $l_0$ otherwise.
